lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {V : E → ℝ} {κ : NNReal},
  1 ≤ κ →
    ContDiff ℝ 2 V →
      (∀ (x v : E), (↑κ)⁻¹ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x) v) v ∧ ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x) v) v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2) →
        ∀ {eta : ℝ},
          0 < eta →
            eta ≤ 1 / 2 →
              have F := fun y x => V x + eta⁻¹ / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2;
              ∃ p,
                Measurable p ∧
                  (∀ (y : E), p y + eta • gradient V (p y) = y) ∧
                    (∀ (y z : E),
                        F y (p y) + ((↑κ)⁻¹ + eta⁻¹) / 2 * ‖z - p y‖ ^ 2 ≤ F y z ∧ (F y z ≤ F y (p y) ↔ z = p y)) ∧
                      LipschitzWith 1 p ∧
                        (∀ (y y' G : E), ‖gradient V (p y + √eta • G) - gradient V (p y' + √eta • G)‖ ≤ ‖y - y'‖) ∧
                          ∀ (y G G' : E), ‖gradient V (p y + √eta • G) - gradient V (p y + √eta • G')‖ ≤ √eta * ‖G - G'‖
approved_definition_context: NNReal is the type of nonnegative real numbers; the upward arrow coerces it to a real. ContDiff R 2 means twice continuously Frechet differentiable. The iterated fderiv is the second Frechet derivative, applied twice to the displayed vector. The C2 premise makes the gradient and derivatives genuine.

E has the displayed real inner-product, complete metric and finite-dimensional structure, with its Borel sigma algebra. Measurable refers to those sigma algebras. LipschitzWith 1 p means distance(p x,p y)<=distance(x,y) for all inputs. The displayed scalar action is real scalar multiplication and sqrt is the nonnegative real square root.

Keep every quantifier, inequality and conjunction, including existence of a single map, the local let-bound real function, the unique-minimum equivalence, and the parameter range. There is no probability law supplied for the vector inputs.
